bounded_question: Can whole-Production Character management operate as a deliberate Production-scope task inside the COMP shell while preserving current-Scene membership/selection, off-Scene Character reality, persistent identity and exact return without creating a permanent People silo or inventing casting/Performer mechanics?
frozen_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
construction_law: Whole-Production Character management is invoked from current Production context and is not a permanent top-level People destination.
Mira is the initial local management selection and remains explicitly off-Scene relative to Scene 12.
Julian remains the stored Scene-12 selection while management selection changes independently.
Opening, selecting, inspecting or reserving creator-edit capacity never implies Scene membership mutation.
Off-Scene means not participating in the current Scene; it does not mean disabled, unavailable, archival or less real.
Character identity remains persistent and independent from Performer/provider assignment.
Creator-authority work must not be presented as fictional Character action, memory, refusal or performance.
Back and Close restore the prior current-situation origin/focus without undoing effective persistent Character material.
mechanical_acceptance: zero page-level and internal horizontal overflow
zero missing button accessible names and zero undersized icon-only controls
management task opens in both themes without changing durable navigation
exactly one local management selection per theme and stored Scene selection remains Julian
Niko can receive independent keyboard focus while Mira remains selected
selecting another persistent Character updates management detail without changing Scene membership or stored Scene selection
Back and Close restore origin trigger focus with current Scene context preserved
zero external resources or image dependency
visual_falsification: Production-scope Character management must read as temporary task depth, not a People database home
off-Scene Characters must remain equally real and legible rather than visually disabled or archival
local management selection, stored Scene selection and keyboard focus must remain visibly different states
teal must not encode Scene membership, off-Scene status, Performer/capability or creator-edit state
narrow layout must preserve Character identity/status before detail and exact return
Light/Dark must preserve identical scope, identity and membership meaning
explicit_non_goals: final Character data schema or creator commit/save/undo contract
production tokens or native WinUI/XAML implementation
result_law: Responsive and interaction-plumbing repairs may change geometry/DOM mechanics only. Any change to accepted Character-management semantics or frozen visual mechanisms requires a separately named successor rather than silent COMP-05 retuning.
